title: Cozy Vanilla+🌿
description: A curated cozy modpack packed with beautiful furniture, immersive ambient sounds, and satisfying particle FX for the ultimate relaxing experience. ✨🧸
body:
A small, custom vanilla+ modpack focused on performance 
and aesthetics.
No overcomplicated stuff here—just a clean, warm atmosphere 
for a relaxing gaming session. Hope you enjoy the vibe! 🤍
This pack focuses on creating a warm, relaxing, and visually 
stunning "Cozy" environment without ruining the core gameplay 
that makes Vanilla Minecraft great. Perfect for long building 
sessions, light exploration, or peaceful standalone gameplay.

## ✨ Key Features
* **Visual Overhaul**: Beautiful, warm lighting, rich particle 
  effects, and enhanced atmospheric details curated to create 
  a cozy aesthetic mood.
* **Performance Boosted**: Optimized using modern performance mods 
  for high FPS, smooth chunk rendering, and fluid gameplay.
* **Vanilla-Friendly**: No overcomplicated tech or magic systems. 
  Everything feels like a natural extension of the official game.
* **Build & Decorate**: Enhanced building and decoration options 
  to help you create your perfect cozy home.
* **Boss Encounters**: Face thrilling boss battles with 
  Bosses Rise! Unique and challenging bosses hidden 
  throughout the world—exciting enough to break up 
  those cozy building sessions! ⚔️
* **Quality of Life**: Smooth animations, clean minimalist UI, 
  and subtle audio improvements to elevate your immersion.
* **Quality of Life**: Smooth animations, clean minimalist UI, 
  and subtle audio improvements to elevate your immersion.

## 💡 Recommended Additions (Not Included)
For the ultimate experience, try pairing this modpack with:
* **Distant Horizons** — Dramatically increases render distance 
  for breathtaking landscapes (requires extra RAM)

These are not included in the pack to keep performance 
friendly for everyone, but highly recommended if your 
PC can handle it! 🖥️✨
